title: Unit Event — Kick It Up a Notch — Episode7 This Song...

meta.Event Outline: Vivid BAD SQUAD is all set to perform at "Crawl Green" and are very excited about it. Kohane and the others are also looking forward to seeing Taiga there, but he happens to get a phone call which...

rows.Speaker: Tatsuya
rows.Line: Now that it's the day of, I guess she's starting to get a little nervous...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
I practiced a lot, so I should be fine...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: All that's left for me is to do what I practiced and produce the best results I can...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, calm down.
How do you guys feel?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Then...
Kohane, you lead our huddle today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, now's your best opportunity.
I mean, just look at everyone's faces.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: None of here think that you don't have what it takes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree. We understand your concerns, but you should be fine.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Because we all believe in you, Azusawa.
Take everything you've gained up to this point and sing to your heart's content on that stage.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I've told you this before, but I don't mind saying it again. I truly, absolutely love the way you sing.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Every time you sing, you light this fire inside me and make me want to also sing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
We believe in you, Kohane.
Which is why we wanna hear you at your best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay! Thanks, An...
You guys as well...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Taiga, An's dad, everyone that came to see us... I want them all to get excited and have fun.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Here we go! Our third event! “RISE”!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Whoa, hey...! Isn't that Ken and Taiga?!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: What? No way! What are they doing here...?!

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Hey, this place is pretty packed.

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Yeah, it is. This place was fairly popular to begin with, but this energy... There's definitely something in the air here...

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Looks like it's starting. Who's going to lead off...?

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Wait, Taiga, did you put her up to this...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Did microphones always feel this cold...? Also, my heart... It's beating so loud...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I was so scared of having to set the pace for this event.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I'm okay now...
Everyone said that they believe in me.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, Kohane, take a deep breath for me... Gently breathe in... And breathe out...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Gently breathe in... And breathe out... Don't think about failing. Erase all those thoughts from your mind.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(The lady in the front...
She let me take photos of her the other day.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(And over there...
It's the lady from the record store who also helped me during practice. Did they all come to see me perform...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (The lady from the crepe shop's also here. The strawberry and whipped cream crepe she gave me was so yummy.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (And I see Taiga and An's dad in the middle. They actually came. It's hard not to notice them since they're both so tall.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Everyone who's been nice enough to help me is here...)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: She isn't singing. Is she nervous or something?

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: What do you think she's gonna sing?

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Also, even though I know you have some experience flying solo, performing by yourself for your own event is something else.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: You'll find out what I mean when you take the stage.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Right. They're not here to just hear me sing. They want to hear us and our music.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They genuinely want to see our performance...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (That fills my heart with so much warmth... I couldn't be happier...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (It's like what I felt that time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I can guarantee that because we've been watching over all of you for so long now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They've been watching over us all this time...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
<Hello there, Kohane. I'm the Miku from your SEKAI.
Nice to meet you.>

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So long as your feelings remain, we'll be right here waiting.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: They've been here this entire time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I didn't think I had anyone until now. I've been hoping that I would someday...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I already have people who are willing to give me all the support they can. They've been right under my nose this whole time.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This warmth I'm feeling is sort of similar to what I felt when Miku and the others helped me make that realization...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(They all want to hear us sing...
I need to answer their call.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want them to hear me sing!)

rows.Speaker: Arata
rows.Line: She's doing even better than she did during practice, and the audience is responding.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(This is so strange...
All that pressure I was feeling a second ago is all gone now.)

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line:
Hey, she's pretty good!
The owner of this place really does have an eye for talent!

rows.Speaker: Audience
rows.Line: Wow! She seems like a totally different person!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I can see everyone's faces so clearly...
They're all smiling and having fun.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
(I think I can sing a little harder.
That might give them a better sense of what I'm feeling...!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: Not bad. That sort of high you feel when you sing on stage. I can feel it through her song.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: Yeah. So this is what she's seeing and feeling.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: I may not be the best teacher, but she's definitely figured out what I was trying to tell her.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: She's singing while looking at each person's face.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: People can convey their feelings to one another by making eye contact. And the same is true for the way someone sings.

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line: But I was confident she was capable of this much.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'm so happy. That means my song's reaching him...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (His booming voice is exciting the rest of the audience...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They're all waving their hands around. I can't tell if this is my voice or if it's someone else's...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (But I want to keep responding to them!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I can go back to where Miku and Luka led me that time...!)

rows.Speaker: Taiga
rows.Line:
(You've gotta be kidding me...
Wh-What am I seeing right now...?!)

rows.Speaker: An's Father
rows.Line: The way she's singing... It's almost as if she's...

rows.Speaker: Kotaro
rows.Line: I-Is it just me or does she look like Nagi...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
(The way she's singing...
I feel unbelievably moved for some reason...!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (My body... It feels electric... How's she doing this...?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: She still hasn't reached her ceiling...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (Is this why Taiga had me walk around the city...?)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (All the people he and An helped me meet and make personal connections with... As well as Taiga himself and An's dad...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (They all want to hear me sing, and I want them to hear me sing.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (This feeling. I can see how important it is when it comes to singing...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Thank you all for listening.
The show's just getting started, so I hope you stay and enjoy yourselves until the end!
